name: C4 Agentic Profile Gate
pass_criteria: docs/architecture/graph/architecture.graph.json exists and node graph/archgraph.mjs validate exits 0 against it
docs/architecture/graph/report.txt holds that validator output from this session, dated
Every edge that crosses a trust boundary carries a protocol and an auth method
Every node of kind service or model names its provider by ontology id, and node ontology/validate.mjs exits 0
Every control node maps to at least one AWS Agentic AI Lens question id
docs/architecture/graph/context.mmd was emitted by archgraph.mjs from the instance, not drawn by hand
notes: C4 has no first-class notation for agents, tools, MCP servers, memory or trust boundaries; the graph schema is the profile that adds them.
